Completion (2026-04-22, via 山东产权交易中心) and the deal amount appear only in press coverage — NOT verified from a primary document, so no amount is stored here. Before this, the company website describes Dachi as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Shandong Shuifa Electric Power Group.
